page.overview:
Who is Stadius?

Captain Stadius was a Starfleet officer who visited Deep Space 9 in 2369.

A reception was held in the captain's honor, which Julian Bashir attended. According to Jadzia Dax, he spent more time concentrating on a female junior lieutenant than the proceedings at hand. ()
